scope: Shared synthetic observation-analysis core and complete Task 1 CLI/GUI/catalogue within OT-053 narrow boundary; empirical and independent user-value gates remain open

shared_boundary.result: Complete roster, measured references, shared perturbations and all variant/visit/draw attempts

task2_requirements: Consume this controlled commit; do not implement a competing estimator, preprocessing or uncertainty procedure
Remove actual observations before evaluate/initialization/interpolation and uncertainty; retain measured 0 and 120 endpoints
Use only retained observations to initialize each visit; never transfer a full-curve state, fitted nuisance, smoothing setting or omitted value
Freeze separate actual reduced input bytes and full-versus-subset identities before evaluation
All visits of a participant retain one allocation; synthetic case construction is development control, not held-out empirical evidence
Use the same whole-body total including basal over 0-120 min, in pmol, and followup minus baseline
Keep C-peptide AUC and glucose context separate; retain all failed variants/draws and planned denominators
Keyed perturbations use only person, draw, visit and retained time, permitting matched retained samples without omitted-data access
Full curve is a reference analysis, not true secretion; no human equivalence margin or clinical sampling recommendation
source_and_integration_notes: The six-file planning patch is identical across OT-053-056; do not replay it twice

Decision 0068 belongs to this core contract; preserve its scientific conventions during integration
